title: CW: CVE-2026-113380 - Signal RingRTC call-hangup bypass via FSM event flooding
exclude_reason: Single obscure source for a Signal CVE; insufficient substance.
content_md: CW: CVE-2026-113380 - The RingRTC call-hangup mechanism used by Signal can be bypassed: an attacker can flood the FSM event queue, so the hangup indication is not delivered.  via Mastodon https://linuxmint.hu/hir/2026/10/a-signal-egy-hibaja-miatt-nem-lehetett-megszakitani-a-csalo-hivasokat
